movimento: Deitado de bruços na mesa flexora, com o peito e o quadril apoiados na almofada do peito e as coxas na almofada das coxas (a máquina é dobrada no quadril, que fica no ponto mais alto), os joelhos logo depois da ponta da almofada das coxas, alinhados com o eixo da máquina (o ponto em que a alavanca gira), e o rolo da alavanca encostado atrás das pernas, logo acima dos tornozelos; as pernas paralelas, afastadas na largura do quadril, os tornozelos com os dedos puxados um pouco para a canela (sem apontar os pés), a cabeça na linha do tronco e as mãos segurando os pegadores dos lados da almofada, na altura da cabeça. Começa com as pernas esticadas, os joelhos só um pouco dobrados (sem travar), e dobra os joelhos levantando o rolo e levando os calcanhares em direção ao glúteo, até o rolo chegar bem perto da parte de trás das coxas, junto do glúteo; volta devagar, esticando os joelhos, até quase esticar. Só os joelhos mexem: o quadril fica colado na almofada (sem levantar o quadril para ajudar), o tronco e a cabeça ficam parados e os pés acompanham as canelas, sem mexer o tornozelo.

cinesiologia.plano: sagital (flexão e extensão do joelho); as canelas giram em volta do eixo dos joelhos, que fica alinhado com o eixo da alavanca da máquina
cinesiologia.articulacoes: joelho (flexão na ida, de ~5° — quase esticado, sem travar — até ~135°; extensão na volta); quadril parado a ~24° de flexão, deitado no V das almofadas (o quadril no ápice); coluna neutra e parada, deitada; tornozelos parados em flexão dorsal leve; ombros, cotovelos e punhos parados, as mãos nos pegadores
cinesiologia.agonistas: isquiotibiais — bíceps femoral, semitendíneo e semimembranáceo (ExRx: alvo "Hamstrings"; NASM: "Hamstring Group (Biceps Femoris, Semitendinosus, Semimembranosus)"), em contração concêntrica na ida e excêntrica na volta; de bruços, com o quadril quase esticado, os isquiotibiais biarticulares trabalham mais curtos que na flexora sentada e cresceram menos no treino (Maeo et al. 2021: "Training-induced increases in muscle volume were greater in Seated-Leg versus Prone-Leg for the whole hamstrings (+14% vs +9%)"); a dobra da máquina no quadril põe o isquiotibial numa posição mecânica melhor (ExRx: "Most machines are angled at user's hip to position hamstring in more favorable mechanical position")
cinesiologia.sinergistas: gastrocnêmio, sartório, grácil e poplíteo (ExRx: Synergists "Gastrocnemius", "Sartorius", "Gracilis", "Popliteus"; NASM: secundários "Gastrocnemius", "Calf Muscles"); com o tornozelo em flexão dorsal o gastrocnêmio ajuda mais (ExRx: "Dorsal flexion of ankle reduces active insufficiency of Gastrocnemius allowing it to assist in knee flexion"). No app só a panturrilha (gastrocnêmio) fica marcada como auxiliar: o grácil e o sartório estão no grupo dos adutores do mapa, que pintaria a parte de dentro da coxa inteira, e o poplíteo é profundo, atrás do joelho
cinesiologia.estabilizadores: tibial anterior e reto femoral (ExRx: Antagonist Stabilizers "Tibialis Anterior", "Rectus Femoris" — o tibial segura o pé em flexão dorsal; "If this angle is sharp (as shown), Rectus Femoris is less likely involved as Antagonist Stabilizer"); o abdome firma o tronco na almofada (ACE: "By engaging (lightly contracting) your abdominal muscles, this will help prevent hip hiking and low back hyper-extension.") e as mãos nos pegadores seguram o corpo no banco (Hoist: "Keep your body on the pads and hands on handles at all times.")
cinesiologia.fases: concêntrica (dobra os joelhos levantando o rolo até a parte de trás das coxas — ExRx: "Raise lever pad to back of thighs by flexing knees"; NASM: "bringing your heels toward your glutes") e excêntrica (volta devagar esticando os joelhos até quase esticar — ExRx: "Lower lever pads until knees are straight"; NASM: "Stop just short of full extension to maintain continuous muscular tension"; NFPT: "Take two to three seconds to lower the pad until it is in the starting position"; Hoist: "Slowly return to start position")

referencias: ExRx.net — Lever Lying Leg Curl (https://exrx.net/WeightExercises/Hamstrings/LVLyingLegCurl, lido na cópia do Internet Archive de 27/01/2026; o site responde 403 direto): classificação "Utility: Basic", "Mechanics: Isolated", "Force: Pull"; Preparation: "Facing bench, stand between bench and lever pads. Lie prone on bench with knees just beyond edge of bench and lower legs under lever pads. Grasp handles."; Execution: "Raise lever pad to back of thighs by flexing knees. Lower lever pads until knees are straight. Repeat."; Comments: "Keep torso on bench to reduce hyperextension of lower back. Most machines are angled at user's hip to position hamstring in more favorable mechanical position. If this angle is sharp (as shown), Rectus Femoris is less likely involved as Antagonist Stabilizer. Dorsal flexion of ankle reduces active insufficiency of Gastrocnemius allowing it to assist in knee flexion."; músculos: Target "Hamstrings", Synergists "Gastrocnemius", "Sartorius", "Gracilis", "Popliteus", Antagonist Stabilizers "Tibialis Anterior", "Rectus Femoris"

NASM — Lying Leg Curl (https://www.nasm.org/resource-center/exercise-library/lying-leg-curl, lido em 07/10/2026): "Lie face down on the leg curl machine with your legs extended and the pad positioned just above your ankles. Ensure your hips remain on the machine throughout the movement."; "Curl the pad upward by flexing your hamstrings, bringing your heels toward your glutes while maintaining controlled movement."; "Extend your legs to return to the starting position with control, maintaining tension in the hamstrings. Stop just short of full extension to maintain continuous muscular tension."; Primary Muscles "Hamstring Group (Biceps Femoris, Semitendinosus, Semimembranosus)"; Secondary Muscles "Gastrocnemius", "Calf Muscles"; Common Mistakes "Allowing the hips to shift or rotate during the movement"

ACE — Prone (Lying) Hamstrings Curl (https://acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/131/prone-lying-hamstrings-curl/, lido em 07/10/2026; é a versão no colchonete com caneleira de cabo/elástico, o mesmo movimento de bruços): "Lie with feet hip-width apart. Gently contract your abdominal / core muscles ("bracing") to stiffen your torso and stabilize your spine. Keep your ankle lightly dorsi-flexed (toes pointed towards your shinbone) throughout the exercise."; "Exhale and curl (bend) your knee, bringing your heel towards your buttock without moving your thigh (the top of your thigh remains on the mat), lifting your hips off the mat or arching your low back."; "Continue bending your knee until your heels near, or touch your buttock, or you reach the limits of your comfort level. The point where you notice your hips or low-back beginning to move indicates that you have reached the limits of movement in your joint."; "Inhale and slowly return your leg back to your starting position."

NFPT — How To Do Lying Leg Curls (Robert Bovee; https://nfpt.com/how-to-do-lying-leg-curls/, lido em 07/10/2026): "Lie face-down on the bench with your knees just off the edge of the pad. Position your body so the leg pads are resting up against the Achilles tendon (just above your ankle). Hold on to the handles located on the either side at head level."; "Bending your knees, raise the leg pad up as far as you can (at least 90 degrees). Take two to three seconds to lower the pad until it is in the starting position."; "Keep your hips against the bench throughout the entire movement."; "Do not bring your hips off the pad or twist your hips as you raise the leg pad up."; "Do not point your toes during this exercise. This will place more stress on your calf muscles."

Dr. Michael Yessis — Lying Leg Curl (https://doctoryessis.com/2013/01/01/lying-leg-curl/, lido em 07/10/2026): "Assume a face down lying position on a leg curl bench (angled bench is preferred)."; "The knees should be beyond the far edge of the bench and the resistance rollers should be adjusted so that they rest against the back of the lower shin."; "Hold onto the grips usually situated by the head or onto the sides of the bench."; "In the finish position the shins should be perpendicular to the thigh or slightly beyond."; "The toes should remain in line with the shins as you execute the exercise."; "If the knee is on the bench, tremendous pressure can build up under the knee cap which can cause injury."; "The angled bench is preferred as it situates the hips up higher and places the upper end of the hamstrings on stretch."

Hoist Fitness (fabricante) — RS-2408 Prone Leg Curl (https://www.hoistfitness.com/pages/rs-2408-prone-leg-curl, lido em 07/10/2026; nessa máquina as almofadas se mexem — "Your support pads are designed to move as you exercise." —, daqui só a regulagem e a execução): "Laying face down on pads, adjust exercise arm so legs are not hyper-extended."; "Position knees aligned with RED PIVOT POINT and ankles under rolling pads."; "Grasp handles and curl legs by bending at the knee."; "Slowly return to start position."; "Keep your body on the pads and hands on handles at all times."
